pima.target_definition: WHO 1980 criteria: 2-hour post-load plasma glucose >= 200 mg/dL during a 75g OGTT
pima.population: Pima Indian females aged >= 21 years (Gila River Indian Community, Arizona)
pima.clinical_type: Laboratory-confirmed physiological measurements (OGTT, serum insulin, blood pressure, triceps skinfold, BMI)

uci_early_stage.target_definition: Clinical diagnosis of early-stage diabetes from patient symptom interviews and clinical records
uci_early_stage.population: Patients attending Sylhet Diabetes Hospital, Sylhet, Bangladesh (Males and Females, age 16-90)
uci_early_stage.clinical_type: Symptom-driven clinical presentation (Polyuria, Polydipsia, sudden weight loss, weakness, Polyphagia, visual blurring, delayed healing, etc.)

healthcare_100k.target_definition: Clinical EHR-documented diagnosis of diabetes (Type-1 or Type-2) and laboratory glucose/HbA1c thresholds
healthcare_100k.population: Diverse outpatient/inpatient healthcare encounters (All genders, age 0.08 to 80)
healthcare_100k.clinical_type: Electronic Health Record (HbA1c %, blood glucose mg/dL, BMI, age, hypertension, heart disease, smoking)

nhanes.target_definition: Self-reported doctor diagnosis of diabetes and/or taking insulin/diabetic pills, matched with examination
nhanes.population: US civilian non-institutionalized population across continuous NHANES cycles (representative multi-ethnic cohort)
nhanes.clinical_type: Standardized physical examination (mercury sphygmomanometer BP, stadiometer height, digital scale weight, waist circumference) + demographic interview

cdc_brfss.target_definition: Self-reported response to telephone interview question: '(Ever told) you have diabetes? (0 = no, 1 = yes/prediabetes)'
cdc_brfss.population: Random-digit dialing telephone survey of non-institutionalized US adults (aged 18+)
cdc_brfss.clinical_type: Self-reported subjective health indicators (general health, mental health days, physical health days, difficulty walking, diet)

frankfurt_hospital_audit.verdict: UNSUITABLE_FOR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION: 99.05% of records are duplicate resamples of Pima Indians dataset. Literature widely treats this erroneously as an independent German hospital cohort.

Cohort_B_Clinical_EHR.name: Healthcare Diabetes 100k
Cohort_B_Clinical_EHR.role: High-Volume Clinical EHR Training & External Validation

Cohort_C_Epidemiological_Physical.name: CDC NHANES Physical Examination
Cohort_C_Epidemiological_Physical.role: Cross-Population Generalization & Subgroup Fairness (Ethnicity, Gender, Age)

Cohort_D_Symptom_Early_Stage.name: UCI Sylhet Bangladesh Early Stage
Cohort_D_Symptom_Early_Stage.role: Domain-Shift Evaluation: Symptom-Based Risk Stratification vs Physiological Risk

Cohort_F_Adversarial_Audit.name: Frankfurt Hospital Germany
Cohort_F_Adversarial_Audit.verdict: Rejected as independent cohort due to 99% data duplication with Pima.
